desc: Reformulate the objective: minimizing grinding cost is equivalent to maximizing feasible \(H\), with answer \(\sum_i(U_i+D_i)-NH\).
Derive fixed-\(H\) upper-tooth intervals: \(H-D_i\le u_i'\le U_i\), allowing final lengths zero.
Derive and verify the direct \(O(N)\) formula for the maximum feasible common height \(H\) using pairwise Lipschitz interval compatibility, including a proof and precise Python implementation plan.
Check edge cases involving zero final lengths, very large values, and 64-bit answer bounds.
